description: Resolve an ASIN, pasted Amazon /dp/ URL, or keywords to a buyUrl (also dual-writes affiliateUrl). Does not invent tracking tags — omits ?tag= until real IDs are configured. ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale.

locale.description: User locale, e.g. en, sv, de, fr

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront domain or id for the end user, e.g. amazon.com, amazon.se, us, se. REQUIRED.

name: resolve_product
title: Resolve buy link
